messages:
Rae (CS): Quick heads-up — several trial tenants are showing "activations pending" after the evening index migration. Need an external status and customer outreach plan.
Evan (CS): How many tenants blocked vs degraded? Any enterprise ones?
Rae (CS): 11 blocked, 7 degraded. Enterprise flagged: NovaMarket, PaperRoad. Full list in the ticket.
Mika (Eng): Triage: migration step triggered cross-tenant dedupe that caused a write queue spike and worker stalls. Applied mitigation to bypass heavy dedupe for in-flight writes at 01:12 UTC.
Mika (Eng): Reingest resumed; catch-up rate ~500 docs/min for priority tenants. ETA ~90m for top two.
Samir (Product): Comms plan: 1) short status email with ETA, 2) offer 48-hour credit for blocked activations, 3) schedule a 30m office hour for impacted teams.
Rae (CS): Draft: "We're aware of activation delays following a migration. Engineers have applied a mitigation; reingest is underway and priority activations should complete within ~2 hours. We'll follow up with a full RCA and an office hour for affected teams."
Evan (CS): Add contact path + incident page link and the credit note.
releases-bot: Hotfix v2026.09.18-dedupe-bypass deployed to prod at 1799998800. CI OK. ✅
Mika (Eng): Long-term fixes: limit dedupe scope during migrations, add per-tenant ingest isolation, and alert on queue amplification. I'll draft infra section for RCA.
Rae (CS): I'll send status email in 10m. Evan please take NovaMarket replies; I'll take PaperRoad. Samir schedule office hour and include a short feedback poll.
Evan (CS): On it. I'll update ticket with customer replies.
Rae (CS): After office hour we'll consolidate feedback into the RCA and publish timeline. Thanks all. 👍
